categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research reagent manufacturing sector, covering four main fields: high-end chemistry, life sciences, analytical chromatography, and materials science. The company also offers a small range of laboratory consumables under its 'Aladdin' and 'Xin Silicon Valley' brands, mainly sold through its proprietary e-commerce platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies including formulation, separation and purification processes, efficient synthesis, standard substance development, modification techniques, analytical methods, packaging, and filling processes. These technologies cover the entire lifecycle from R&D to final product formation, with some reaching international advanced levels. The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment and innovation in synthesis, purification, and analytical techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include universities, research institutes, and R&D departments of enterprises in biomedicine, new materials, new energy, energy conservation, environmental protection, aerospace, and other high-tech and strategic emerging industries. The end users are mainly scientists and frontline R&D engineers requiring high-quality research reagents and consumables.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong presence in East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Singapore, the United States, and Ireland to support international market development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the R&D, production, and sales of research reagents and laboratory consumables. It integrates supply chain management with e-commerce sales, controlling procurement, production, quality inspection, warehousing, and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding its product portfolio in high-end chemistry, life sciences, analytical chromatography, and materials science, with a focus on import substitution. It invests heavily in R&D, with 12.72% of revenue allocated to research in 2023, developing new reagents, improving formulations, and enhancing production processes. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and e-commerce platform enhancement to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of research reagents and laboratory consumables via its proprietary e-commerce platform and third-party platforms such as Tmall and JD.com. The sales model is characterized by frequent, small-batch purchases from a dispersed customer base, mainly scientists and researchers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the most comprehensive domestic producers of research reagents in China, recognized for its 'Aladdin' brand. While international giants from the US and Europe dominate the market, Aladdin has made significant progress in import substitution and holds a competitive position domestically, being repeatedly recognized as a top chemical reagent brand and a leading specialized SME.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 403 million, a 6.55% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of about RMB 85.8 million, a 7.48% decrease due to increased expenses. The company has steadily grown over the past three years, with increasing R&D investment and expanding product lines. Total assets reached RMB 1.5 billion with a net asset value of over RMB 1 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aladdin emphasizes import substitution to provide high-quality, domestically produced research reagents with competitive pricing and shorter delivery times. Its comprehensive product range, strong R&D capabilities, robust quality control, and integrated e-commerce platform offer customers convenience, reliability, and a broad selection tailored to diverse scientific research needs.
